description: Wave 6D-1 strictly read-only console-only clean-room probe catalog confirming matching xNVSE event system, ShowOff pre-activation, and ShowOff batch 2/3/4/5 behaviors against original Fallout: New Vegas 1.4.0.525.

batches.title: Wave 6D-1 - Confirmed xNVSE & ShowOff Observed Matches

probes.claim: Verify DispatchEventAlt return value (0 vs >=1 handler), fewer vs exact vs extra handler params, calling ref 0:: base-form match, case-insensitive string filter, FormList filter, and live-mutated array filter.
probes.expected: Fewer params run; verify extra params; 0::rDocBase matches rDoc; string filter is case-insensitive; mutating filter array via ar_Append changes live matching.
script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w6d1_05_dispatch_event_alt_arity_and_filters|ret=%g/%g|arity(0=%g,3=%g,selfDoc=%g)|flt=%g,%g,%g" rNone rHit c0 c3 s0Doc f1 f2 f3

nvseprobe_s_w6d1_05_a3.gek: begin Function { int a, string_var b, int c }
nvseprobe_s_w6d1_05_flt.gek: begin Function { int a, string_var b }

probes.claim: Verify GetCurrentEventName outside any handler, inside SetEventHandler, SetEventHandlerAlt, ShowOff:OnAdd, and JIP SetOnHealthDamageEventHandler.
probes.expected: Empty string outside; exact event name inside xNVSE/ShowOff handlers; verify inside JIP handler.
script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w6d1_06_get_current_event_name_contexts|out=[%z]|std=[%z]|alt=[%z]|add=[%z]|jip=[%z]" sOut sStd sAlt sAdd sJip

nvseprobe_s_w6d1_06_jip.gek: begin Function { float fD, ref rS }

probes.claim: Verify xNVSE OnDrop args/GetSelfAlt, xNVSE OnAdd silent on AddItem but firing on world pickup, and ShowOff:OnAdd GetSelfAlt on AddItem (0) vs world pickup (world ref).
probes.expected: AddItem fires ShowOff:OnAdd (self=0) only; Drop fires OnDrop (dropper, worldRef); world Activate fires xNVSE OnAdd (worldRef, container) + ShowOff:OnAdd (self=worldRef).
script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w6d1_09_on_drop_and_xnvse_on_add|ai(add=%g,so=%g,soS0=%g)|drp(n=%g,a1P=%g,a2Ref=%g,sP=%g,s0=%g)|pick(add=%g,a1W=%g,a2P=%g,so=%g,soSW=%g,soS0=%g)" addAfterAI soAfterAI soSelfAI0 drpN drpA1P drpA2Ref drpSP drpS0 addAfterPick addA1W addA2P soAfterPick soSelfPickW soSelfPick0

probes.claim: Verify ShowOff:OnPreScriptedActivate multi-handler priority (20 void -> 15 veto 0 -> 10 dynamic 3::1 vs 3::0 -> 5 SetFunctionValue 1 sticky veto).
probes.expected: Order S:V20(1),Z15(1),F0(0),U5(0), dynamic 3::1 skipped, sticky veto keeps caps unchanged.

probes.claim: Verify whether mutating SetDestroyed 1 inside a void ShowOff:OnPreScriptedActivate callback prevents pickup of a placed Bottle Cap.
probes.expected: Check cap pickup count before/after SetDestroyed 1 inside void callback.

probes.claim: Verify scripted Activate bypasses ShowOff:OnPreActivate while firing ShowOff:OnPreScriptedActivate, and check GetEventHandlers empty-Map vs ar_Null for all ShowOff events.
probes.expected: ShowOff:OnPreActivate count=0 on scripted Activate; all ShowOff:* events return empty Map (size 0) in GetEventHandlers.

probes.claim: Verify UnequipItems triggerOnUnequip=0 vs 1 with OnActorUnequip, plus GetEquippedItems (ammo exclusion, mask 32 vs 1<<20), BitMask, WeaponRef, and ItemRefForItem.
probes.expected: Check triggerOnUnequip=0 vs 1; confirm ammo excluded and mask 32 picks weapon.

probes.claim: Verify GetBaseEquippedWeight vs GetCalculatedEquippedWeight minWeight comparison (>= vs >) and whether minWeight tests base weight or perk-reduced weight under Pack Rat (2.0 -> 1.0).
probes.expected: With Combat Knife (weight 1.0 -> 0.5 under Pack Rat), compare GetCalculatedEquippedWeight at minWeight 0.5, 0.51, 0.75, 1.0.

probes.claim: Verify SetAllyTemp and SetEnemyTemp override saved SetAlly/SetEnemy reactions until a subsequent SetAlly/SetEnemy overwrites them.
probes.expected: SetEnemyTemp overrides SetAlly; subsequent SetAlly overrides SetEnemyTemp; SetAllyTemp overrides SetEnemy.
script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w6d1_32_showoff_ally_enemy_temp_precedence|init=%g,al=%g,enT=%g,alOver=%g,en=%g,alT=%g,rest=%g" c0 cAl cEnT cAlOver cEn cAlT cRest

probes.claim: Verify Matrix_IsMatrix empty/ragged, 1-D Matrix_ApplyOperationWithMatrix (+, %, * 3x1), Quaternion_GetMatrix [0,0,0,0], and Matrix3x3_GetQuaternion on identity, 90-deg Z, and 180-deg X/Y.
probes.expected: 1-D + and % stay 1-D; zero quat gives -1 diagonal; check Matrix3x3_GetQuaternion on 180-deg X/Y vs 90-deg Z.
script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w6d1p2_33_matrix_and_quat_edges|is=%g,%g|1d(add=%z:%g,sch=%z:%g,mul=%g:%z)|q0=%g:%.1f|qid=%g|qrz=%g(%.3f,%.3f)|qrx=%g" mEmp mRag tAdd (aAdd[2]) tSch (aSch[2]) mulSz tMul q0Sz q0d szId szRz rzW rzZ szRx

probes.claim: Verify ToggleQuestMessages read/toggle return values, ResetInteriorAlt on exterior CELL (Sunny's parent cell) vs non-CELL, FreezeAmmoRegen, PickpocketEquippedItems, and ItemHotkeyIconPath override/reset.
probes.expected: ToggleQuestMessages reads 1 on / 0 off; ResetInteriorAlt returns 0 on exterior CELL and non-CELL; ItemHotkeyIconPath onlyOverride=1 returns empty without override.
script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w6d1_34_showoff_toggle_quest_msg_and_reset_int|tqm=%g,%g,%g,%g,%g,%g|ri=%g,%g|fa=%g,%g,%g|pp=%g,%g|ic(defLen=%g,o0=[%z],ov=[%z],clr=[%z])" q0 qM1 qOff qOff2 qReadOff qOn riExt riBad fa0 fa1 fa2 pp0 pp1 (sv_Length icDef) icOnly0 icOver icClr

probes.claim: Verify ResetInteriorAlt on a true exterior CELL (GSMapMarker 0xCDF51 parent cell, isInt==0) and Matrix3x3_GetQuaternion on 90-deg Z and 180-deg X/Y rotations.
probes.expected: ResetInteriorAlt returns 0 on true exterior CELL; Matrix3x3_GetQuaternion returns w>=0 unit quaternions.

probes.claim: Verify GetCalculatedAPCost (whatAttack 0/1/2 on Power Fist, Brass Knuckles, Combat Knife, Baseball Bat, 10mm Pistol, Fists) and GetCalculatedItemValue on placed ref, damaged ref, inv ref, and non-item door.
probes.expected: Check unarmed override AP vs Fists, melee whatAttack=1 VATS AP, and GetCalculatedItemValue condition scaling & -1 on non-item.
script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w6d1_36_showoff_calc_ap_cost_and_item_value|pf=%g/%g/%g|kn=%g/%g/%g|kf=%g/%g|bt=%g/%g|val(full=%g,dmg50=%g,bad=%g)" pf0 pf1 pf2 kn0 kn1 kn2 kf0 kf1 bt0 bt1 vFull vDmg vBad

probes.claim: Verify GetVATSTargetable on living/disabled/dead NPC and non-actor door, FastTravel/SleepWait override flags, SetForceDrawHitscanProjectiles, SetProjectileTracerChanceOverride, and SetIsPCAMurderer.
probes.expected: Disabled/dead NPC and door return 0 for GetVATSTargetable; EnableFastTravel 0 flips override; switches return prior state.
script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w6d1_37_showoff_vats_fast_travel_and_switches|vats(liv=%g,dis=%g,ded=%g,dr=%g)|ft(%g,%g,%g,can=%g)|sw(%g,%g)|hs(%g,%g,%g)|tr(%g,%g,%g,%g)|m(%g,%g)" vLiv vDis vDed vDr ftO0 ftO1 ftO2 ftC0 sw0 sw1 hs0 hs1 hs2 tr0 tr1 tr2 tr3 m1 m0

probes.claim: Verify ForceRecoilAnim on 1H melee (Combat Knife anim 1), thrown (Frag Grenade anim 10), dead NPC, and non-actor door; IsActorInvisibleToPlayer & HighlightAdditionalReferenceAlt with Chameleon/Invisibility; GetNumCombatActorsFromActor in live combat.
probes.expected: ForceRecoilAnim returns 1 for 1H melee, 0 for thrown/dead/door; IsActorInvisibleToPlayer=1 with Chameleon>0 and HighlightAdditionalReferenceAlt(1) returns 0 vs (0) returns 1.

probes.claim: Verify ShowSkillMenu 3, SetLevelUpMenuCanExitEarly (open 1/0 vs closed), SetLevelUpMenuCurrentPage (same page 0 vs close 2), SetOwnershipTemp on placed ref, and GetZoneRespawns with live SetZoneFlag.
probes.expected: SetLevelUpMenuCanExitEarly returns 0 closed, 1 open; SetLevelUpMenuCurrentPage 0 returns 0 when already on page 0; SetOwnershipTemp updates GetOwner.
script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w6d1_39_showoff_levelup_early_exit_and_spell_usage|lu(exCl=%g,op=%g,pg0=%g,pts=%g,ex1=%g,ex0=%g,same=%g,cl=%g,aft=%g)|own(%g,%g)|zone(%g,%g,%g)" exCl sOpen pg0 pts ex1 ex0 pgSame pgClose pgAfter ownSet ownOk z0 z1 z2

probes.claim: Verify GetCalculatedActorSpread crippled-arm penalties for anim types 0 (Power Fist), 1 (Combat Knife), and 11 (Frag Mine), plus PlayerHasNightVisionActive, PlayerIsDrinkingPlacedWater, GetIsActivationPromptShown, IsPlayerLookingAround, and PlaceAtReticleAlt bounds.
probes.expected: Anim 0, 1, and 11 have 0.0 crippled-arm penalty; misc status getters return 0 when idle; PlaceAtReticleAlt clamps distance to [min, max].
